title: Homily In transfigurationem rem early
english: Rem early: Homily In transfigurationem; historia and theoria toward Christ.
translator_notes: Copy-text: PG 77; Homilia in transfigurationem via Khazarzar (Commentarii in Lucam In transfigurationem.pdf).
